import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
test('the watchdog reads the installed unit from the real service manager', (t) => {
  try {
    const unit = readFileSync('/nonexistent/worklane/unit-name', 'utf8').trim();
    const r = spawnSync('systemctl', ['is-active', unit], { encoding: 'utf8' });
    assert.fail(`the systemd assertions ran (${r.status})`);
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof assert.AssertionError) throw e;
    t.diagnostic(`no installed unit here: ${e.message}`);
  }
});
